comportamentos: Clicking the show ('olhinho') action for a dismissal no longer raises an internal error: present (candidate restricts show columns, removing the virtual enrollment_level column)
Show view displays the enrollment level (Nível de Matrícula) via the dismissal_level_show_column helper: missing (candidate shows date instead of level)
Virtual column renamed from enrollment_level to level (search condition, search helper and pt-BR translation): missing
justificativa: The candidate probably stops the error by limiting the show columns, but the show view differs from the official fix: it omits the enrollment level, includes date, and does not rename the virtual column to level, which the official search, helpers and translations depend on.
